WITH district_counts AS (
    SELECT a.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS account_count
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id, d.A3
), regional AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count,
           AVG(account_count) OVER (PARTITION BY region) AS region_avg
    FROM district_counts
), above_average AS (
    SELECT district_id, region, account_count,
           account_count - region_avg AS excess,
           account_count * 1.0 / AVG(account_count) OVER () AS ratio
    FROM regional
    WHERE account_count > region_avg
)
SELECT district_id, region, account_count, excess, ratio
FROM above_average
ORDER BY ratio DESC
